name: Recommend reorder quantities from ERP stock levels with Claude and approve in Slack

parameters.content:
## Recommend reorder quantities from ERP stock levels with Claude and approve in Slack

Operations teams that decide reorders from a spreadsheet and want the maths and the exceptions done for them.

### How it works
Trigger: Runs after the demand-forecasting workflow writes new forecasts; a daily run checks stock positions against reorder points.
1. Read forecasts and error
2. Read inventory and open orders
3. Measure supplier lead times
4. Compute safety stock and reorder points
5. Classify SKUs
6. Generate purchase suggestions
7. Explain parameter changes
8. Publish to buyers and the ERP
Every AI step is followed by a "Needs a person?" gate that parks low-confidence items.

### Setup
1. Open "Config (edit me)" and fill in the fields (names, approver, quiet hours, thresholds).
2. Add credentials: Anthropic, plus ERP / WMS (NetSuite, SAP B1, Cin7, Fishbowl), Google Sheets.
3. Run once with test_mode on, read the output, then switch the trigger on.

### Customization tips
Put your service levels and lead times in the Config node; connect the ERP node to NetSuite, SAP B1, Cin7 or Fishbowl.
Guardrail to keep: Draft POs only — a buyer approves before anything is sent to a supplier.

Full blueprint: https://agentmelt.com/workflows/inventory-optimization/

## Trigger and config
The entry point and the one node you edit: names, approver, quiet hours, test mode.

## 1. Read forecasts and error
p50 forecast and p90–p50 spread per SKU-location-week from the forecast table, plus measured forecast error by SKU segment

## 2. Read inventory and open orders
On-hand, allocated, in-transit and open PO quantities from the ERP or WMS, and receipt history for lead-time measurement

nodes.name: Section: 2. Read inventory and open orders

parameters.content:
## 3. Measure supplier lead times
Mean and variance of actual lead time per supplier-SKU from PO created → received, replacing the ERP's static lead-time field

## 4. Compute safety stock and reorder points
Safety stock from the service-level target, forecast error and lead-time variability; reorder point = lead-time demand + safety stock; order quantity from EOQ or supplier minimums and pack sizes

nodes.name: Section: 4. Compute safety stock and reorder points

## 6. Generate purchase suggestions
Every SKU-location whose projected position (on-hand + in-transit − forecast over lead time) falls below the reorder point becomes a suggestion, grouped by supplier into a draft PO

## 7. Explain parameter changes
Where a reorder point moved more than 20%, the agent states why in one line: forecast up, lead time slipped, error widened

## 8. Publish to buyers and the ERP
Suggestions go to the buyer sheet with approve/adjust; approved lines are pushed to the ERP as draft POs via API

options.systemMessage:
You are the "Explain parameter changes" step of the Inventory Optimization Workflow workflow run by Agentmelt.
Task: Where a reorder point moved more than 20%, the agent states why in one line: forecast up, lead time slipped, error widened. Buyers see the reasoning before they approve.

Rules:
- Draft POs only — a buyer approves before anything is sent to a supplier.
- Parameter changes above a threshold are explained and can be frozen per SKU.
- Service-level targets are set by finance and operations together, and the achieved level is reported weekly.
- Supplier lead times come from receipts, not from the master data, so the numbers reflect reality.
- Answer only from the data provided in the input. If something is missing, say so in the output instead of guessing.
- If this step produces a message or a document, put the full text in `draft` (and a `subject` if it is an email); put a one-line summary in `summary`.
- Set `needs_human` true whenever you are unsure, the input is unusual, or a rule above applies; a person will look at it.
- Return valid JSON matching the output schema; no prose outside the JSON.
